description.value: Stellar's Jaye Community Pub is a local gathering spot in the North Coast & Haida Gwaii region, one of BC's most remote and scenically dramatic cycling destinations. As a community pub, it likely serves as one of the few social and dining hubs in the area, making it a notable stop for touring cyclists passing through. The wheelchair-accessible venue offers indoor seating.
